title: Zhen Ding posts strongest May revenue as server optical module shipments surge
content: Zhen Ding Technology Group reported that May consolidated revenue reached a 2026 high as robust demand for high-end AI products drove significant year-over-year growth, the company said. The firm attributed the performance to a sharp uptick in server and optical module shipments, which rose nearly 2.5 times year-over-year, and strong momentum in IC substrate sales, which grew nearly 80% year-over-year.

title: Samsung Foundry turns to 5nm, 8nm orders as 2nm comeback takes shape
content: Samsung Electronics is pursuing a two-track foundry strategy, accelerating its 2nm push for future customers while asking partners to step up sales of its 5nm and 8nm processes to support near-term utilization, according to ZDNet Korea.

title: BOE says glass-based packaging substrate pilot line has yet to reach mass-production yield
content: BOE Technology Group's push into glass-based packaging substrates remains short of mass production, even as the Chinese display maker expands into new materials and advanced display technologies to build growth beyond conventional panels.

title: Transcend says Samsung DDR4 supply secured through 2027 as memory prices rise
content: Transcend Information said revenue for April and May combined has already surpassed its first-quarter total, as tight memory supply and elevated prices continue to lift sales at the Taiwan-based memory module maker.

title: Sercomm posts record first five months as North America drives 2026 revenue surge
content: Sercomm Corporation reported May 2026 revenue of NT$6.48 billion (approx. US$205 million), up 70% year-over-year, and said cumulative revenue from January to May reached NT$30 billion, a 55.3% increase that set new company records for both monthly and year-to-date sales. The telecom broadband equipment maker attributed the gains to stronger North American demand and accelerating orders tied to AI-driven network traffic growth, executives said.

title: AI cooling lifts heat spreader shipments at Niching
content: AI-driven high-speed computing and data transmission are driving up chip performance and cooling requirements worldwide, and Niching Industrial Corp. said its acquisition of Ming June Yuan will help improve profitability as the market shifts toward larger, hotter-running chips and more advanced thermal materials.
